mentions.name: Industry project management SaaS
mentions.description: This SaaS is a project management tool built for the commenter's father's industry, covering roughly 25% of full ERP functionality, sold to other companies in that industry on monthly recurring subscriptions.
mentions.audience: Other companies in the commenter's father's industry.
mentions.source_excerpt: I actually did this for my father's industry in 2016. Took a break from my sales job, and built him a project management tool about 25% of the way to an ERP tool. I've sold a few monthly recurring accounts to other companies and overall the people that like it enough to finish onboarding seem to like it.
